issue.description:
ADR-002 makes agent-guided rehydration the only sanctioned migration path and defines the reconciliation report's disposition vocabulary (native id, omitted, merged, unresolved) plus required provenance (source repository and commit), but no documented artifact specifies the report's structure, storage location, or how batching and resumability work for large repositories — the ADR itself lists these as unmet needs. Write a versioned report spec with a reviewable template, restate that the report is never accepted as native store input, and reference it from the field guide docs.

issue.description:
ADR-004 commits to a pinned MSRV verification lane in `bead-rs-ci` (a `cargo +1.85 check --all-targets` step) so the declared 1.85 floor is tested on every run instead of asserted, and states that drift between the lane's toolchain and the manifest's `rust-version` is a CI failure. No open bead covers this lane. Implement it in the Argo Workflows template for bead-rs CI (declarative-config, k8s/iad-ci/argo-workflows/ — GitHub Actions stay disabled), pin the lane toolchain to exactly the manifest's `rust-version`, fail the run when `rustc --version` in the lane does not match the manifest declaration, and record the lane's green evidence on the bead. Dependency-refresh unpinned ranges and the committed Cargo.lock resolution from the same ADR are already recorded as done (2026-08-22); this bead is only the missing verification lane.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Add the pinned MSRV 1.85 verification lane to bead-rs-ci with manifest drift check (ADR-004)
